name: Water Warriors
what_you_do: Join a student team that protects the Chattahoochee River. In the school year you do cleanups and talk to peers about the river. In summer, high schoolers can shadow staff in the field and lab.
who_can_apply: High school and college students. The page lists no ages or grades.
pay_detail: Not stated. The page describes service hours and does not mention pay or a cost.
duration: School-year program Oct 2026 to April 2027; summer shadowing for high schoolers (dates not stated)
deadline_text: 2026-27 application closed Monday Sept 21, 2026. Next cycle not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on the Water Warriors page. You can also sign up there for emails about Water Warriors news and events.
notes: In summer, high school students can test water samples, check CASSI units and clean trash traps with staff. Contact: Jillian Griffin, jgriffin@chattahoochee.org, or 404-352-9828.
